picks.title: Epic launches Connectors to link its AI tools with third-party apps
picks.excerpt: Epic launched a new capability that lets its artificial intelligence agents access information and perform tasks in third-party applications. Through "Connectors," developers can connect their apps to Epic's AI tools (Emmie, Art and Penny) as well as custom AI agents organizations create through Agent Factory.
picks.rationale: Epic's new Connectors let its clinician and patient AI agents (Art, Emmie, Penny) act inside third-party apps, a product release that reaches care teams at the largest EHR vendor. No Epic story appears in the 30-day history.

picks.title: 복지부·WHO, AI 헬스케어 서울선언문 채택...의료 AI 최종 판단은 인간이
picks.excerpt: 보건복지부와 세계보건기구(WHO)가 보건의료 분야 AI 활용 과정에서 의료인의 감독과 인간의 최종 판단을 보장하는 내용의 AI 헬스케어 서울선언문을 채택했다.
picks.rationale: An official declaration adopted by Korea's health ministry and the WHO that requires clinician oversight and a final human judgement for healthcare AI, so it reaches regulators directly. The full URL (idxno=3014484) is new, and no WHO or Seoul-declaration story appears in the history.

picks.title: A Generative AI-powered navigation system for precision CBCT-guided lung biopsies: a randomized controlled trial
picks.excerpt: Lung puncture biopsy is the gold standard for diagnosing lung nodules, but poor CBCT image quality and limited guidance intelligence slow procedures. This randomized controlled trial tests a generative-AI navigation system for CBCT-guided lung biopsies.
picks.rationale: A randomized controlled trial of generative-AI navigation during CBCT-guided lung nodule biopsy, which is interventional AI tested on patients. It differs from the 10-17 lung-screening EHR identification card in both procedure and evidence type.

picks.title: Avenda Health adds intraoperative Surgery Mode to Unfold AI
picks.excerpt: Avenda Health added an intraoperative Surgery Mode to Unfold AI, letting surgeons use AI-generated prostate cancer maps built from a patient's MRI, biopsy and other data during procedures.
picks.rationale: A new Surgery Mode in Avenda's Unfold AI that brings AI-built prostate cancer maps into the operating room, a product release used by surgeons. The earlier prostate cards (RadNet biopsy avoidance on 10-10, MRI detection parity on 10-14) covered diagnosis rather than intraoperative use.

picks.title: Multi-site real-world performance of commercial AI for pulmonary and incidental pulmonary embolism detection
picks.excerpt: A retrospective multi-site evaluation of two FDA-cleared Aidoc BriefCase algorithms, one for PE triage on dedicated CT pulmonary angiography and one for incidental PE, characterizing their real-world performance.
picks.rationale: A multi-site real-world check of two FDA-cleared Aidoc pulmonary embolism algorithms already in clinical use, which tells radiology departments how deployed AI performs outside its clearance data. No PE or Aidoc story appears in the history.
